methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native represent grassroots peer-to-peer knowledge transfer that could build distributed fluency outside traditional tech hubs, directly counteracting concentration dynamics.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI industry campaign contributions to NoVA lawmakers despite local resistance reveals how capital and political influence concentrate around data center infrastructure, deepening the metro capability moat even amid backlash.

signals.title: VCU partners with the Better Business Bureau to bring AI support to Central Virginia businesses - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-BBB partnership bringing AI support to Central Virginia businesses signals platform-mediated adoption that spreads geographically but may create shallow, vendor-dependent usage rather than deep internal capability.

signals.title: ODU, CHKD want to map hotspots of childhood asthma in Hampton Roads with AI - WHRO
signals.signal_reading: ODU and CHKD deploying AI for asthma mapping demonstrates research institution-led deep technical application, but concentration in university-hospital partnerships limits distribution beyond credentialed knowledge workers.

signals.title: Grant program aims to expand Southwest Virginia’s behavioral health workforce by making training more affordable - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Grant funding for behavioral health workforce training addresses critical needs but makes no mention of AI/tech capability development, signaling that rural workforce development remains disconnected from the AI transition.
